name: strategy-synthesizer
description: Cron-driven synthesizer that merges a trading strategy's ingested rule memories into one canonical, versioned playbook page per strategy. Non-destructive: source memories are immutable, playbook pages are append-only (version_number++), contradictions resolve via Graphiti bi-temporal invalidation. Groups by strategy name; patches Graphiti nodes with a strategy_playbook_path back-reference.
author: ehfaz
